Answer: C
Reason: The frontal chest X-ray shows a prominent left superior mediastinal contour (indicated by the arrow), which is characteristic of a persistent left superior vena cava. In the context of dyspnea and mild hypoxemia with otherwise clear lung fields, this finding supports the diagnosis of a PLSVC draining into the left atrium, creating a right-to-left shunt.
